svg.title: Smooth separated moments make the preceding profile integrals ordinary Bochner integrals, proving every component of wQ(k) →w0 Q. For numerical regulator arrays, order-zero Wilson coefficients are Gaussian Wick contractions of reduced local polynomials. The common field-address identity identifies these with the free labels. With fixed refinement base L > 1, denominator Lm, spacing L−m and periods growing faster than each fixed polynomial margin, the Gaussian row limit holds for every refining subsequence and moving grid tuple tending to distinct continuum positions. The profile sum then gives wQ,0(m) −→w0 Q. (PT14)
